title: thermoLEO Index v1
description: A single-number index (0-100) summarizing the state of the upper thermosphere (550-1550 km) derived from LEO satellite altitude distributions. Higher values indicate more anomalous conditions.
author: Natanael A. Junior

method.I1: Mean skewness across bands, INVERTED (negative = risk)
method.I2: Skewness of 550 km band, direct (saturation = risk)
